summary: CipherChat iteration-2 testing complete. Backend: 39/39 pytest cases PASS (22 regression + 17 new) — covering attachments upload/download/413/non-member 404, WebSocket realtime message + typing broadcast, invalid-token WS close, group admin add/remove with key_epoch increments & system messages, new-member cannot see history, stale key set 409, removed member 404 on chat, self-leave + admin-leave with admin transfer, /api/register-push requires auth, placeholder push does not block message send. Frontend (mobile 390x844): two-browser realtime verified — message from A visible on B within 0.51s via WS (well under 2s target), chat-subtitle shows 'WS_A_84738 IS TYPING…' when A types, decrypted bubble matches sent plaintext. Set-PIN flow accepts 6 digits twice via set-pin-key-N testIDs and returns from set-pin screen. CRITICAL BUG: on page reload after enabling app lock, SettingsScreen crashes with 'TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading boxPub)' at settings.tsx:38, falling through to ErrorBoundary 'Something went wrong' — the lock-screen never gets a chance to render. Root cause: SettingsScreen reads identity.boxPub synchronously during the brief window when AuthProvider is still rehydrating the session from AsyncStorage/IndexedDB on web. Attachments UI (attach-sheet, file picker), group admin UI (add/remove/leave), and biometric/screenshot toggles were not reached due to the reload crash blocking app-lock verification; the backend endpoints they call are all green.

ui_bugs.issue: Crashes with 'Cannot read properties of null (reading boxPub)' at /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx:38 — `keyFingerprint(identity.boxPub, identity.signPub)` runs before `identity` is hydrated after reload. Repro: enable app-lock in Settings → reload page → ErrorBoundary 'Something went wrong'. Fix: early-return a loading state when `!identity || !user`, or move fp computation inside a useMemo guarded by identity.

integration_issues.issue: Could not confirm lock-screen appears after enabling PIN + reload because SettingsScreen crashes first (see above). Backend/lock-provider logic likely fine; blocked by the hydration crash.

action_items: Fix SettingsScreen null-identity crash: guard `keyFingerprint(identity.boxPub, identity.signPub)` behind `if (!identity || !user) return <Loading/>` or useMemo; this blocks the entire app-lock reload acceptance criterion.
After fix, retest: (a) toggle app-lock-switch → set PIN → reload → lock-screen shows → wrong PIN shows lock-pin-error → correct PIN unlocks → toggle off → reload → no lock-screen.

Remaining UI flows not tested in this run (backend already green, worth a quick spot-check after fix): attach-button→attach-sheet→attach-file-option file upload producing attachment-file-<id> bubble; group chat-header-info → add-members / remove-member / confirm-remove / leave-group with system-message-<id> rendering and chat-removed on the removed user's screen.

server.py:544 strict `set(body.keys.keys()) != set(chat.member_ids)` returns 409 on stale sealed set — verified for post-add scenario.
server.py:120 notify_new_message catches *every* exception from send_push → messaging never blocked by push failures. Good.

settings.tsx:38 reads `identity.boxPub` without null guard — root cause of post-reload crash. Hooks `useSession()` can return `{user:null,identity:null}` momentarily on web where secure storage is async.

rca_of_issue: Bug: SettingsScreen crash on reload. Repro: 1) Register user, 2) Open Settings tab, 3) Toggle app-lock-switch, 4) Enter PIN 123456 twice on set-pin, 5) Reload page. Observed: ErrorBoundary with 'Cannot read properties of null (reading boxPub)'. RCA: On web, secure storage (AsyncStorage/IndexedDB) rehydration is async. During the first paint after reload, `useSession()` returns `{user:null,identity:null}` and settings.tsx:38 unconditionally dereferences `identity.boxPub`. The AuthProvider route guard in _layout.tsx redirects unauth users to /auth, but during the hydrate tick the Settings route is already mounted (/(tabs)/settings is persisted). Mitigation: add `if (!user || !identity) return null;` (or a skeleton) before line 38 in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/settings.tsx. Same pattern should be audited in other authenticated screens that read `identity.*`.
